sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 429 numbered subject rows / 384 family-card identities and 82 unnumbered artist entries across 22 sections are reconciled to original PDF text-object cells. Original unlabelled text columns remain separate from the adapter Actor, Character, Relic / prop and Artist fields. Repeated dual/triple signers, Christopher Daniel Barnes, printed Pocanhontas and Ian Mckellen, and both sketch rosters are retained. The revised source adds IA-TZ Tom Holland / Ian Lightfoot. The October 21 release is upcoming. All 76 odds categories retain PACK#1, PACK#2 and BOX TOPPER columns, null dashes and two literal 1:XX placeholders. The sheet does not name a ratio unit; no per-pack calculation is made. One explicitly named Immortal Autographs SuperFractor limit is retained; unnamed card-specific guide examples and sketch artwork uniqueness do not number the other parallels or artist roster entries. Exhaustive parallel and numbering coverage remains unverified.
The two published 1:XX values are unresolved placeholders; no numeric odds are invented.
Exhaustive numbering and family eligibility remain unverified.
